featured_reviews.name: Shivam Kendre
featured_reviews.review_text:
Avoid Cruiseland Weddings & Events at all costs.

Rutwesh and Darshika sold us a dream and delivered disarray. They should just start calling themselves decorators, as planning needs management & coordination, and they have none of it.

My cruise wedding this year was almost ruined due to these guys. They charged a 15% commission while failing to provide even the basics: no proof of the crane service they claimed to book(charged us 3 lakhs), missing key décor items like bajots for our wedding rituals, spoiled gajras, phantom charges for port passes and flower petals, arguing and fighting with our photographers and i can go on.

No ownership, no apology, and zero refunds for what was clearly negligence and mismanagement.

Cordelia Cruises should seriously reconsider associating with planners this careless.
